<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918160_theRebbe_102" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918160_theRebbe_102__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the soul's service in the body, a new quality is drawn into the soul from the revelation of the Essence's choice in the body.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that this—that through the service of the soul in the body a new matter is produced in it</t>
    <t s="2">(which is above even its root),</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">that the choice of the Holy One, blessed be He, in Israel is not only in the body of Israel but also in the soul</t>
    <t s="5">[This itself—that the souls are children to the Holy One, blessed be He—is because He so chose with His free choice].</t>
    <t s="6">However, in the soul, which has the quality of "son,"</t>
    <t s="7">the matter of choice is in concealment.</t>
    <t s="8">And through the service of the soul in the body,</t>
    <t s="9">in which the choice of the Essence is revealed,</t>
    <t s="10">this revelation is drawn also into the soul.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The difference between the two explanations is that according to the second, the revelation through service is primarily for the resurrection when the soul is clothed in the body.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Now, among the differences between the two explanations is,</t>
    <t s="1">that according to the first explanation—the body is only like an intermediary through which the root of the soul is revealed.</t>
    <t s="2">Therefore there is room to say,</t>
    <t s="3">that after the root of the soul is revealed through service in the body,</t>
    <t s="4">the soul has no need for the body.</t>
    <t s="5">But according to the second explanation—even the revelation drawn to the soul through its service in the body is the drawing of the matter of the choice of the Essence, which belongs</t>
    <t s="6">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="7">to the body,</t>
    <t s="8">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="9">the revelation through the service of Torah and mitzvos will be primarily at the resurrection of the dead,</t>
    <t s="10">when the soul will be clothed in the body.</t>
    <t s="11">And this can be connected with the known statement</t>
    <t s="12">that in the future the soul will be nourished from the body—because the revelation that will come to the soul in the future is the drawing of the revelation of the choice of the Essence, which belongs</t>
    <t s="13">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="14">to the body.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The future redemption will include a great material wealth, even greater than the wealth of the Exodus, because it is a revelation of the Essence's choice.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">With this, what was explained above will be understood</t>
    <t s="2">[in the maamar beginning "Kimei Tzeisecha" of the last day of Pesach]</t>
    <t s="3">—that the verse compares the future redemption to the redemption from Egypt,</t>
    <t s="4">"As in the days of your going out from the land of Egypt, I will show him wonders,"</t>
    <t s="5">this applies to all the matters that were in the Exodus,</t>
    <t s="6">including also the matter of great wealth that was in the Exodus.</t>
    <t s="7">And just as all the matters of the future redemption will be in a manner superior to how they were in the Exodus</t>
    <t s="8">[as per the well-known interpretation</t>
    <t s="9">of "I will show him wonders"—</t>
    <t s="10">that the wonders that will be in the future redemption will be wonders even relative to the wonders that were in the Exodus],</t>
    <t s="11">so too regarding the great wealth that will be in the future redemption,</t>
    <t s="12">it will be great wealth even relative to the great wealth that was in the Exodus.</t>
    <t s="13">And this is also understood from what our sages, of blessed memory, said,</t>
    <t s="14">that Yosef hid three treasures in Egypt, etc., and one is hidden for the righteous for the future to come,</t>
    <t s="15">for no matter departs from its simple meaning,</t>
    <t s="16">that the treasure hidden for the righteous for the future is</t>
    <t s="17">(also)</t>
    <t s="18">a treasure of physical silver and gold.</t>
    <t s="19">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="20">that in the days of Moshiach all delicacies will be as plentiful as dust,</t>
    <t s="21">as the Rambam ruled.</t>
    <t s="22">And explanation is needed,</t>
    <t s="23">for the matter of the days of Moshiach is that then the earth will be filled with knowledge of the L-rd as the waters cover the sea,</t>
    <t s="24">and physical matters will not occupy a place</t>
    <t s="25">[to the extent that the entire world's occupation will be only to know the L-rd alone],</t>
    <t s="26">so what relevance is there that there will be great wealth then?</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
